items.rationale: The drilling appears to prepare the frame for the new pane, so it is glazing work under 1.3 and excluded by 3.5 because optional glazing cover is not shown. If covered, one drilling operation would be about €30 gross.
Fitting the pane is glazing work excluded under 2.6.4 and 3.5, even though the timber frame repair is covered. If glazing cover applied, one fitting would be about €90 gross.

The cabinet pane is a glazing element even though it is set in insured furniture, and 2.6.4 and 3.5 exclude its replacement without optional glazing cover. If covered, one like-for-like cut-to-size pane would be about €130 gross.

The impact damage to the timber frame is covered separately from the glass under 2.6.1 and 4.2.6. Under 7.1.1(b) and 7.1.5, about €265 in labour plus €25 in materials covers local filling, sanding and finish blending; no deductible amount is stated.

items.description: Repair and refinish chipped wooden shelf
items.rationale: The bowl impact caused the shelf damage, so 2.6.1 covers it and 7.1.5 limits the work to the damaged area. Allow about €150 in labour plus €15 in materials to repair the chip and blend the finish.

Under 7.1.12, one attendance by this contractor is payable in full if covered timber repairs were performed on that visit, without apportionment for the glazing work. Allow €40 gross for one local visit.
